literal.prompt: Какое вещество обычно составляет около половины массы тела взрослого человека?

literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax 26.1 L35-L37 gives adult body water at 50–60% of body mass, with age variation down to 45%; this supports “usually about half”. The other answer labels name body constituents but none is the roughly half-mass fluid identified by the source. Water is the only key. Iron’s heme role is separately grounded at 18.3 L44-L47; calcium and collagen are grounded as distinct bone-matrix constituents at 6.3 L89-L90 and 4.3 L83,L138.

literalGroups.literal: Вода обычно составляет 50–60% массы тела взрослого человека; в пожилом возрасте доля может снижаться примерно до 45%. Вода служит средой для химических реакций организма.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax 26.1 L35-L37 states body water is about 50–60% of adult mass and can fall to about 45% in old age. L31 explains that life’s chemical reactions occur in aqueous solutions. The explanation retains those qualifiers.

literalGroups.literal: Железо входит в гемоглобин; атомы железа в нём связывают кислород.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax states hemoglobin contains iron in its heme groups; each heme iron ion can bind oxygen. This is a concrete fact about iron and the note does not retain the unsupported enzyme claim.

literalGroups.literal: В мозге и почках вода составляет около 80–85% массы этих органов.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax identifies brain and kidneys as having the highest tissue water proportions, 80–85% of their masses. This is an additional fact about water beyond the prompt/key.

literalGroups.literal: Соли кальция образуют минеральные кристаллы костной ткани, придающие ей твёрдость.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Calcium phosphate and calcium carbonate form hydroxyapatite crystals in bone; these mineral crystals give bone hardness and strength. This is specifically about calcium salts.

literalGroups.literal: Коллагеновые волокна образуют белковую основу матрикса кости и придают костям гибкость.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax identifies collagen fibers as fibrous protein subunits and says collagen is the main organic component of bone matrix, providing flexibility. This is a specific fact about collagen.
